sentences.text: The instant application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ('Cr.P.C.') has been filed on behalf of petitioner seeking grant of interim bail in case FIR bearing no. 14/2022 registered at Police Station Special Cell, Delhi for offence punishable under Sections 406/467/468/471/420/120B of Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC') on the ground of surgery of wife of the accused.
2. Briefly stated, the facts of the case as per prosecution are that complainants had made a joint bid for 3 plots of DDA in 2018 and had won the said bid.

sentences.text: The complainants had then agreed to purchase the said properties however, the properties were never allotted to them and the complainants had filed a complaint which had culminated into present FIR.
On 01.05.2023, present accused/applicant was arrested and has been in judicial custody since.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant states that applicant herein had surrendered before proceedings under Section 82 CrPC could be initiated against him.

It is stated that applicant's wife had earlier undergone a surgery for removal of ectopic and tubes which had resulted in formation of a 7x4mm sized endometrial polyp and she was advised to undergo surgery for the same which was scheduled for 09.11.2023 however, it could not be conducted since there was no attendant at the hospital and since present applicant could not be released on interim bail, the surgery was postponed which is now scheduled for 20.11.2023.
He further states that his wife resides alone and his sons reside outside of India and there is no other family member to take care of her after the surgery, therefore,
bail application be allowed.

Learned APP for the State, on the other hand, states that the Investigating Officer has verified the medical documents filed alongwith the application.
It is stated that the State has verified the fact that wife of the applicant has to undergo surgery scheduled on 20.11.2023.

He further states that learned Trial Court had dismissed interim bail application moved by applicant vide orders dated 06.11.2023 and 08.11.2023.
5.
I have heard arguments addressed on behalf of applicant and the State and have perused material on record.

6. In the present case, accused/applicant herein, in collusion with other accused persons had allegedly cheated complainants on the pretext of allotting DDA land to them and help them releasing the forfeited amount from the DDA account.
7. The applicant has sought interim bail on the ground of surgery of his wife which is scheduled on 20.11.2023 and her post-operative care.

A perusal of status report reveals that two weeks' care of patient is required, the State also mentions that the present accused/applicant has two sons who are not living in India since they are residing in Australia and Saudi Arabia.
It is stated by learned counsel of applicant that it is a major surgery that the wife of applicant has to undergo, and thus the presence of applicant is required.

8. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and since the factum of surgery of his wife has been verified by the State, this Court inclined to grant interim bail to the petitioner for a period of 07 days beginning from 19.11.2023 till 25.11.2023.
